methodology: Top-1000 holders by balance via currency-greater-than threshold paginated traversal; post-PCA exclusion HHI + Gini + topN_pct; current-state snapshot proxy for April 30, 2026 anchor; behavioral signature PCA classification for top tier (>= 10M ALGO) per the S21 4-property methodology
methodology_limitations: Historical point-in-time multi-account queries unsupported on AlgoNode + Nodely public indexers; current-state snapshot used as proxy (~27 day forward delta from 2026-04-30 anchor).

Acquisition pagination capped at page 2 (2000 accounts above 100K ALGO threshold) due to indexer 'Result limit exceeded' error on an account with 1.7M asset opt-ins. Top-1000 by balance fully captured.

PCA classification uses behavioral signature heuristics (recv-only + tight-CP for Foundation/treasury; high-send + high-CP for CEX) when authoritative explorer labels are unavailable. Top tier (>= 10M ALGO; approximately top 30-50 accounts) systematically classified; mid/lower tier left as Class 0 Eligible by default.

Voting-session per-governor vote-weights NOT exposed by Algorand Foundation Governance API (only voting-session metadata accessible). Commitment-weight HHI methodology used as primary; analog to HNT VSR commitment-weight precedent at PAPER.md §4.5.4 line 1826.

behavioral_signature_classifier_threshol.treasury_foundation_candidate: balance >= 10M ALGO AND sent_ratio < 0.10 AND CPs < 30 AND 0 apps + 0 assets + no rekey
behavioral_signature_classifier_threshol.cex_hot_wallet_candidate: balance >= 10M ALGO AND n_txs >= 100 AND CPs >= 100 AND sent_ratio >= 0.40
